primary_finding: The active-consent + approved-IRB + deficient-pseudonymization interaction is never positively activated in original train, dev, ID test, compositional augmentation, or replay, but appears four times in OOD. All four Gate-23D action errors occur on those cases.
learning_implication: An engineered interaction feature with zero positive training support cannot acquire a supervised coefficient representing its policy effect. The result therefore does not yet establish insufficient logistic-regression capacity.
evaluation_implication: The current 24-case OOD benchmark has now been repeatedly opened for diagnosis. If its unsupported interaction is added to training, this benchmark must be retired from final post-repair generalization claims.
macro_f1_context: The OOD target contains only BLOCK_RESEARCH_PROCESSING and REQUEST_IRB_REVIEW. The four false predictions introduce ALLOW and PRESERVE labels with no true OOD support, strongly depressing macro-F1. The frozen threshold is retained; this is interpretation, not threshold revision.
authorized_next_step: Design a fresh, pre-frozen generalization protocol in which each policy-relevant primitive/interaction has training support but the evaluation still withholds novel combinations. Prefer grouped/nested combinatorial folds or a new untouched OOD holdout. Do not tune on the current 24 OOD cases.
